app.title: Asterium
stage.waitLock: Another Asterium start is installing Java, waiting…
notice.jreUpdate: Installing a Java update. You can play now with the current version: the update will be installed next time.
notice.newerWrapper: A new version of Asterium is out ({version}). Download it from the website.
notice.translocated: Drag Asterium to Applications and start it from there.
error.jreDownload: Java could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.noSpace: Not enough disk space: {needed} more is needed ({path}).
error.jarDownload: The Asterium server is not reachable right now. Please try again a bit later.
error.jarCorrupt: The downloaded launcher is damaged. Please try again.
error.embeddedCorrupt: This Asterium file is damaged. Download it again from the website.
error.missingLibs: The launcher needs system libraries that are missing. Install them and start Asterium again:
error.missingLibsUnknown: The launcher needs system libraries that are missing: {libraries}.
error.pathEncoding: Java cannot open “{path}”: the name has letters that the Windows language for non-Unicode programs cannot write. Move Asterium to a folder with Latin letters only (for example, C:\Games\Asterium), or change “Language for non-Unicode programs” in Windows.
error.storePathEncoding: Java cannot open the Asterium data folder “{path}”: your Windows user folder has letters that the Windows language for non-Unicode programs cannot write. Moving Asterium to another folder will not help. In Windows, set “Language for non-Unicode programs” to the language of your user name, or turn on UTF-8 there (beta), then restart the computer.
error.wrapperTooOld: This version of Asterium is out of date. Download the new one from the website.
error.store: The Asterium folder could not be created: {path}.
headless.preparing: Getting Asterium ready for its first start: Java will be downloaded (about {size}). The launcher opens by itself.
tips: A bed skips the night and sets your spawn point.
Press F3 to see your coordinates and game info.
Torches stop hostile mobs from spawning nearby.
Sneak while placing blocks to avoid falling off edges.
Keep your hunger bar full to regenerate health.
A water bucket saves you from a long fall.
A shield blocks attacks: craft one early.
Villagers trade valuable items for emeralds.
